name: The Yandere
tagline: 196,956 objects of obsession — clocks, chains, and a whole lot of red.

facts.note: A mega-collaboration hosted, verified and published by Dorami, themed on Yandere Simulator. Dorami's 98% fail during verification is one of the community's most-circulated clips. The 80-86% section, widely called the hardest part, is by Spectex, FarDreamer and GdTheTactiq.

theme.mood: Black and arterial red, nothing in between. Ghost clock faces turning behind everything, chains, gears, and a torn paint swash under a title that looks cut rather than typed.

voice.hook: This level's intensity is almost unmatched.
voice.why:
The Yandere by Dorami holds another special place in my heart. I think this level's intensity is almost unmatched, and the theming is something so unique it's amazing. In my friend unaura's words, “They just don't make levels like these anymore,” and I think that is just the truth. This is another level where I think it does the song so much justice.

My favorite part must be the end again, right after Spectex's part. Spectex was given the part right before the final drop, and I think he mastered the idea of building suspense and tension here. His transition with his logo, switching to the level saying “FAR,” is one of the coolest things in the entire game, despite being pretty simple.

Watching Dorami verify this also made this level engrained in my memory. When he failed at 98% with Topi in the room, I think the entire community felt his pain, and it was a coming-together moment to all cheer for Dorami to verify the level. When he finally did, it really was something special that not many levels do.

arc.label: Spectex's part
arc.note: Given the run-up to the final drop, and he mastered it.

arc.label: The logo transition
arc.note: Switching to the level saying “FAR.” Simple, and one of the coolest things in the game.

arc.label: The final drop
arc.note: The end. My favorite part, again.
Dorami's fail, with Topi in the room. The whole community felt it.
